name: Darwin
description: NT capital and gas demand hub, terminus of the Amadeus Gas Pipeline (AGP) from Central Australia.

name: Darwin LNG / Port Precinct
description: Wickham Point/East Arm industrial and LNG precinct near Darwin, served by the Darwin Spur off the AGP.

name: Cosmo Howley
description: Junction on the Amadeus Gas Pipeline (AGP) where the Blacktip to Cosmo Howley pipeline connects in.

name: Blacktip Field
description: ENI-operated offshore gas field in the Bonaparte Basin, feeding the NT gas network via Cosmo Howley.

name: Katherine Junction (AGP)
description: Where the Katherine Lateral taps off the Amadeus Gas Pipeline (AGP) mainline.

name: Katherine
description: NT regional town served by a short lateral off the Amadeus Gas Pipeline (AGP).

name: Tennant Creek Junction (AGP)
description: Where the Tennant Creek Lateral taps off the Amadeus Gas Pipeline (AGP) mainline.

name: Tennant Creek
description: NT regional town served by a lateral off the Amadeus Gas Pipeline (AGP).

name: Palm Valley
description: Central Petroleum-operated gas field, southern origin of the Amadeus Gas Pipeline (AGP).

name: Alice Springs
description: Central Australia's largest town, served by a lateral off the Amadeus Gas Pipeline (AGP) via Palm Valley.

name: Mereenie
description: Central Petroleum-operated gas field west of Alice Springs, feeding the Amadeus system via Tylers Pass.

name: Bayu-Undan Field
description: Santos-operated offshore gas field in the Timor Sea, feeding Darwin LNG.

name: Ichthys Field
description: Inpex-operated offshore gas field in the Browse Basin, feeding Ichthys LNG near Darwin.
